title: implement raytrace_triangle

atoms.evidence: same (O, D) form, used to derive the per-ray solve
stack([-D, B-A, C-A]) and the (s>=0 & u>=0 & v>=0 & u+v<=1) inside-test — Moller-Trumbore lifted to batched form
A, B, C = einops.repeat(triangle, 'pts dims -> pts NR dims', NR=NR) — broadcast triangle across rays
mat = t.stack([-D, B - A, C - A], dim=-1) on (NR, 3, 3)
O, D = rays.unbind(dim=1) and s, u, v = sol.unbind(dim=-1) — explicit unbind on non-first axes
dets = t.linalg.det(mat); is_singular = dets.abs() < 1e-8; mat[is_singular] = t.eye(3); ... & ~is_singular — same trick as 0_1_2, now with 3x3

notes: 8 atoms — first dense composing exercise of part1, exactly as predicted. The singular-matrix-mask-trick recurs here in 3x3 form; triangle-barycentric stays composite (Moller-Trumbore matrix + inside-test fire together every time, as predicted in seed Q4). einops.repeat is the natural way to broadcast a single triangle across NR rays.
